request: Advanced-route deliverable: SLED grant clawback risk for FY24. Pull FY24 (2023-10-01 through 2024-09-30) federal grants awarded to state/local/educational recipients from USASpending. Award types 02/03/04/05. Derive per-award clawback-risk signals: outlay stagnation ratio (Award Amount - Total Outlays) / Award Amount for awards >=180d past Start, unspent_dollars, recipient_name_count per prime_award_recipient_id. Publish two DSes to Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent. Fed Register signal join and FY25 renewal join are handled at dashboard time from existing DSes.

sources.name: USASpending SLED Grants FY24
sources.description: USASpending.gov POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award for FY24 SLED grants. award_type_codes 02/03/04/05, recipient_type_names limited to state/local/educational governments. Sorted by Award Amount desc. Body-mode pagination via 'page', 100 per page, cap 50 pages / 5000 rows.

recipient_type_names: State Controlled Institution of Higher Education
Public/State Controlled Institution of Higher Education

args.name: SLED FY24 Trend
args.features_description: Per-award FY24 SLED grant records with days_since_start and calendar features. Compute per-award outlay stagnation ratio in Tableau via (Award Amount - Total Outlays) / Award Amount, filtered to days_since_start >= 180.
args.stats_description: Long-form FY24 SLED grant statistics keyed by (Awarding Sub Agency, state). Includes monthly award counts, dollar totals, and z-score anomalies for concentration.

outputs.name: SLED Grants FY24 Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level federal FY24 grants (2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30) to state/local/educational recipients. Award types 02/03/04/05. Includes Award ID, Recipient Name, Award Amount, Total Outlays, Awarding Agency + Sub Agency, Award Type, recipient state / county / city, Start / End dates, prime_award_recipient_id, days_since_start, and calendar features (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Source: api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award. Refresh: monthly.

Advanced-route notes: clawback risk is a SIGNAL score, not a formal recovery determination. Use in Tableau by joining to: (a) 'USASpending SLED Grants' (FY25-26) on prime_award_recipient_id + Awarding Sub Agency for the F4.1 renewal boolean; (b) 'Fed Register Actions' filtered to termination/rescission keywords, joined on Awarding Sub Agency for F3 program-status signals. The joined signal score is intentionally left as a Tableau calc so operators can tune the weights.

outputs.name: SLED FY24 Sub-Agency Stats
outputs.description: Per-Awarding-Sub-Agency and per-state FY24 SLED grant rollups: award count, dollar totals, monthly rolling counts, z-score anomalies. Use in Tableau to identify sub-agencies with unusually concentrated FY24 SLED activity or state distributions.
